title: pedicularis resupinata subsp. crassicaulis
intro: Pedicularis resupinata subsp. crassicaulis, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the bumblebee flower genus, is a type of flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Pedicularis resupinata subsp. crassicaulis include expectorant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential applications.
